title: World Cup 2026: Tuchel axes Foden, Palmer in surprise England shake-up
summary: England manager Thomas Tuchel made a series of bold selection calls for the World Cup, leaving out star names including Phil Foden and Cole Palmer from his 26-man squad. Tuchel said team unity mattered more than individual talent as England bids to end its 60-year wait for a major men’s trophy.
